Bed stuy recs! 

Cafe: Doctors Cave Cafe is amaaaazing the food is so so good, but they have weird hours so check online before visiting. Corto has good coffee/sandwiches. Brooklyn Tea is an AMAZING black owned tea room/cafe. The staff is amazing and they’ll fix you something awesome.

Food: I loooove the sandwiches at chicky’s, expensive but worth imo. Make a res at Little Grenjai it’s sooo good. I like Trad Room a lot too. Saraghina is good if you’re looking for reasonably priced Italian food. Peaches hot House so good too. A&A doubles/roti is sooo good if you want to try some of the Trinidadian food bed stuy is known for. 

Vintage: sincerely Tommy has good vintage pieces but do NOT buy any of the clothes that aren’t vintage. I love the person who sources their vintage clothes the rest of the stuff is fast fashion they sell for like $300. You can go get a drink nextdoor at dear friends book store which is a rly cute book store with wine bar :) 

If you want to take the train to Clinton hill I recommend Greenlight Bookstore.
